# Named color RGBA values

Source: [Color constant RGBA values](../archive/4975.md); page edited 2024-12-30.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/4975.md#wiki-4975) before using these values.

Channels are red, green, blue, alpha; each is in 0–255. FG markup availability is a separate runtime question.

## Contents

- [Static colors](#wiki-4975-table-1)

## Static colors

| Color | RGBA | Foreground code payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
| White | 255, 255, 255, 255 | fgFFFFFFFF |
| Yellow | 255, 255, 0, 255 | fgFFFF00FF |
| Green | 69, 255, 87, 255 | fg45FF57FF |
| Purple | 161, 73, 197, 255 | fgA149C5FF |
| Red | 200, 0, 19, 255 | fgC80013FF |
| Blue | 39, 170, 255, 255 | fg27AAFFFF |
| Aqua | 0, 234, 234, 255 | fg00EAEAFF |
| Orange | 236, 153, 0, 255 | fgEC9900FF |
| SkyBlue | 108, 190, 244, 255 | fg6CBEF4FF |
| Turquoise | 0, 230, 151, 255 | fg00E697FF |
| LimeGreen | 160, 232, 27, 255 | fgA0E81BFF |
| Gray | 127, 127, 127, 255 | fg7F7F7FFF |
| Violet | 100, 50, 255, 255 | fg6432FFFF |
| Rose | 255, 50, 145, 255 | fgFF3291FF |
| Black | 0, 0, 0, 255 | fg000000FF |
